accounting.rationale: Original PDF127 lines26-28 defines the named-constant category and two declaration forms. The extent/bound effect is p3; no separate no-op definition program is created.
The PARAMETER and prior-definition requirements remain8.5.13; an ordinary local variable, dummy or runtime-allocated object is not an implied-shape named constant.

The initializer is a complete constant expression of valid type/kind and conforming rank under8.2p4. The number of stars still determines declared rank; it is not silently replaced by the initializer rank.
R825/R823 provides the single assumed-implied specification. Its named-constant role gives implied shape, unlike the same spelling on an assumed-size dummy.
R826 supplies at least two assumed-implied specifications; a scalar explicit prefix followed by a star is instead R824 and is not a named-constant admission.
R401 makes the following list nonempty. Therefore this production is not the single-star alternative.

requirements.title: The multiple-star implied-shape form has at least two assumed-implied specifications
requirements.definition: An implied-shape-spec is an assumed-implied-spec followed by a comma and a nonempty list of further assumed-implied-specs. Every dimension uses the R823 star form, optionally with its scalar lower bound. R825 supplies a single dimension; R824's explicit scalar prefix is not this form.

pending.multiple-star-admission: PENDING complete INTEGER named constants with two and three star specifications and matching-rank constant initializers. A previously defined explicit-shape PARAMETER seed of shape[2,3] or[2,1,3] can supply the initializer; a flat rank-one constructor is not implicitly reshaped.
pending.specified-star-lowers: PENDING named constants with mixed omitted and explicit constant scalar lower bounds, such as v(-1:*,7:*), using a complete rank-two constant seed. Apply R823/C853; no vector-bound or component-array-spec expansion.
pending.constant-initializer-role-source: PENDING exact C838/C837, C807, C853,8.2p4 and array-constructor/constant-expression relations. Keep one canonical owner for any malformed-role/type/rank/constancy negative. Header/declaration anchor and role-schema needs remain gated; no duplicated canonical syntax cases.

requirements.oracle: Finite role-valid multi-star admissions with complete constant initialization, and separate run/effect rank/bound plans. Alternative valid parses must be excluded before a syntax negative is authored.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No scalar rank-zero interpretation from an empty initializer, automatic reshaping, runtime allocation substitute, forced fatal/code/English policy or unsupported-feature credit. No line coalescing or widened span to bypass C830-ANCHOR-001.

requirements.title: An implied-shape array is a named constant
requirements.definition: An implied-shape array is a named constant. This does not waive mandatory constant initialization, named-constant bound/type-parameter constancy, prior definition, type/kind conformance or the rank equality required for implied-shape initialization.

pending.named-constant-admission: PENDING complete INTEGER PARAMETER arrays using the shared single-star and multi-star forms, with earlier constant seeds or valid constant array constructors of matching rank. Do not require the PARAMETER keyword to occur on one particular source line if another legitimate canonical specification confers the attribute.
pending.ordinary-variable-excluded: PENDING a complete unit with a prior rank-two INTEGER constant seed and ordinary v(*,*)=seed, with no other specification making v a named constant. Repair only by adding PARAMETER to v's declaration. Require the actual named-constant-role cause, not an initializer rank error or unsupported star syntax; preserve separate source anchors and C830-ANCHOR-001 gating.
pending.initialization-owner-source: PENDING exact canonical controls for missing/nonconstant initialization, mismatched initializer rank, nonconstant lower bounds and invalid type/kind/constructor inputs. C807, R805/C1012,8.2p4 and C853 own those distinct predicates; a source/diagnostic/role gate is not permission to relabel them as C838.

requirements.oracle: A focused ordinary-variable exclusion with a one-attribute valid repair, plus complete named-constant admissions and precise canonical initialization prerequisites.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No fabricated local-variable, dummy, component or allocation admission. Required reporting capability is not a forced fatal exit or printed code. Unsupported features, broad constant/kind/expected strings, source echoes, ICE and wrong-source recovery do not identify the role predicate.

requirements.title: Implied-shape rank counts its assumed-implied specifications
requirements.definition: The rank is the number of assumed-implied-specs in the array-spec. The initializer must have that rank under8.2p4; it does not override the declaration's count. Zero extent or zero total size does not make the named array scalar.

pending.single-star-rank: PENDING a run/effect with INTEGER,PARAMETER::v(*)=[11,13], checking direct RANK(v)=1, SIZE=2 and the defined values. The actual named object, not a constructor or fixed-rank destination, is queried.
pending.multiple-star-rank: PENDING complete constant seeds of known shape[2,3] and[2,1,3], each used to initialize the corresponding two/three-star named array. Require direct literal ranks2/3 and ordered shapes; do not infer declared rank from the seed as the test oracle.
pending.zero-extent-not-scalar: PENDING a rank-one empty constant initializer and a rank-two constant seed with shape[0,3], giving named arrays of ranks1 and2 respectively and total size0. A scalar initializer is not a substitute for the rank-one empty array, and no element is read.

requirements.oracle: Real run/effect observations of complete named constants, with independently fixed rank/shape/value expectations and valid constant-expression/rank premises.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No count-filling declaration-only program, compile-only substitute, fixed-destination RANK or role retagging. Admission-only/source-use needs still require appropriate canonical evidence and a separately source-approved control-facet designation.

requirements.title: Initializer extents and stated or default lower bounds determine implied-shape bounds
requirements.definition: Each dimension takes its extent from the corresponding dimension of the constant initializer. Its lower bound is the specified lower-bound or one; its upper bound is lower plus extent minus one. This is not allocation/argument association and does not copy the initializer object's lower bounds. Empty-dimension inquiry results retain their separate normalization rules.

pending.initializer-extents: PENDING a previously defined constant seed of shape[3,2] and a matching two-star named array, checking literal SHAPE=[3,2], SIZE=6, direct rank2 and defined values. The expected shape is not queried from a second potentially affected descriptor.
pending.specified-and-mixed-lowers: PENDING v(-1:*,7:*) from that shape[3,2] seed, expecting whole-object lower[-1,7], upper[1,8]; and v(-1:*,*) expecting lower[-1,1], upper[1,2]. Every bound expression must satisfy C853, not merely the general specification-expression context rules.
pending.defaults-not-inherited: PENDING a constant seed with nonunit bounds[-2:0,4:5] and v(*,*)=seed. Expect v lower[1,1], upper[3,2], shape[3,2]; do not copy seed's lower bounds as ALLOCATE(SOURCE=) or a dummy-association proxy.
pending.zero-extent-normalization: PENDING a rank-two constant seed with shape[0,3] and v(5:*,-2:*)=seed. Require rank2, shape[0,3], size0, LBOUND=[1,-2], UBOUND=[0,0], with no element access. A rank-one empty v(-2:*) has LBOUND=[1], unlike an ordinary assumed-size dummy's special last-lower inquiry.
pending.constant-lower-source: PENDING canonical C853 lower-bound constancy and prior specification-inquiry controls. A bound depending on a variable is not allowed merely because the declaration is in a procedure, but a previously specified constant-property inquiry can be constant despite mentioning a variable. Retain C853/C1012/8.2 ownership and exact report/role gates.

requirements.oracle: Actual named-constant rank, shape, bounds and defined-value runs with independent literal expectations. Constant initialization, declaration rank and lower-bound selection remain distinct source premises.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No whole-size sentinel interpretation, runtime allocation/assumed-shape copy model, unavailable or empty-element read, byte/kind folklore, descriptor/TRANSFER self-oracle, or compile-only weakening. The literal upper-bound relation is not an unconditional UBOUND result for an empty dimension.
